raw:
@s1 stated
  relation "be built by"
  role subject "the bridge"
  role object "the firm from Deva"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted
  valid on "last year"

@s2 stated
  relation "be over"
  role subject "the bridge"
  role object "Someș"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s3 stated
  relation "be at"
  role subject "the bridge"
  role object "Ciceu-Mihăiești"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s4 stated
  relation "be damaged"
  role subject "the bridge"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@q query
  select ?n
  where match
    relation "build"
    role subject ?n
    role object "the bridge"
    polarity affirmed
  end
